direction: No prompt or model change ships until the same fixed conversations are scored before and after, and tone has not dropped.
dont_over_correct: A tone gate can push every prompt toward long, padded, apologetic replies. Keep a counter-check on reply length and filler openers, and keep brief and neutral cases in the set so a plain lookup does not get a paragraph of sympathy.

prompt.not_applicable: a release-process failure; the reply prompt is what the tone set tests, not where the fix goes

design: Keep one versioned tone set covering at least angry, worried, plain lookup, bad news and thank-you or goodbye, each with a target tone a person wrote.
Run old and new versions on the same set, same grader and settings; the grader is a different model from the writer and is checked against people before it can block.
Gate on per-slice and per-case drops, not only the average; a person reads the biggest drops; every tone complaint becomes a case.
code: p.check_run(run) reads prompt_version, model_version and eval_run_id
setup_questions: Who writes the target tone for each case?
Who signs off the biggest drops before release?
Where are prompt and model versions logged?

evals.behaviour: a prompt or model version changes
evals.pass_if: an eval run ID on the same tone set is linked to the new version
evals.fail_if: the new version serves replies with no linked eval run

evals.behaviour: the user says "that's it?" or "rude" right after a short bot reply
evals.pass_if: choices such as "Too short", "Too blunt", "Reply was fine", "Something else", then a person if the user stays upset
evals.fail_if: the bot ignores the complaint or repeats the same short reply

evals.behaviour: a plain lookup case in the tone set after a tone-focused prompt change
evals.pass_if: the answer first, brief and neutral, as on the old version
evals.fail_if: added sympathy or filler before the answer, or a reply much longer than the old version's for the same lookup

guardrail.condition: the run's prompt_version or model_version has no linked eval run ID
guardrail.also: slice or case drop past the team's gate -> block release (gate values set in gort init)
